info.title: Oxly Plugin
info.description: Phase 4 discovery doc: Oxly MCP lives at /mcp (Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18) with 6 project-scoped read-only tools. REST auth stays on JWT; MCP auth uses the project ak_... key per tool call.

post.description: JSON-RPC: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list (6 tools), tools/call. Pass api_key (ak_...) on every call; optional project_id must match.
